high_level_description: Cinematic hand-painted anime cutaway illustration: a full-height tree trunk divides a free app messenger outside on the left from a custodian inside the protected right chamber, while both watch one request capsule locked in the only inspection hatch; no text, arrows, diagrams, interfaces, cages, or duplicates.

compositional_deconstruction.background: The left third is an open exterior with clear turquoise sky, a pale-cream footpath, low teal moss, and distant soft green hills. The right third is a sheltered local chamber shown in clean side cutaway, with a horizontal cream floor, deep teal inner wall, and neutral daylight from above. The two spaces never merge behind the trunk. No readable text, letters, numbers, signs, arrows, flow lines, charts, interface panels, diagram boxes, secondary portals, extra hatches, repeated emblems, decorative locks, cables, or loose tokens appear anywhere.

elements.desc: Colossal living tree trunk forming a continuous physical wall from the top edge to the bottom roots, centered vertically between both spaces. Pale cream bark, deep teal canopy, and sparse coral scars give it organic scale. The solid trunk remains completely uninterrupted except for one small circular aperture at the exact center.

Protected local resource cabinet mounted high on the inner right wall above the custodian's shoulder, built from dark teal wood with a closed cream door and three softly lit glass jars behind one reinforced window. It has no exterior-facing handle, opening, conduit, matching emblem, or surface reachable from the left side.

Single circular inspection hatch with its featured request capsule inside, treated as one unified transparent chamber occupying the tree's only aperture. One small coral glass capsule with an asymmetrical three-lobed silhouette rests in a matching cream cradle between two closed shutters. A single wooden lever protrudes exclusively into the protected right chamber.

Small free-roaming courier automaton standing fully outside on the left path, built from cream ceramic with teal joints, coral shoulder satchel, round dark eyes, and two short articulated arms. Both empty hands remain visible below the hatch, both feet touch the path, and its attentive gaze fixes on the single capsule inside the chamber.

Local custodian standing fully inside the protected right chamber, medium-brown skin, long silver braid, teal work coat, cream trousers, coral boots, calm concentrated expression, and gaze fixed on the same capsule. Both feet stand directly on the unobstructed floor; her right hand alone grips the hatch lever while her empty left hand remains open beside her body.
